spans.s:
इव ind.
1 Like, as (showing
उपमा or comparison); वागर्थाविव
संपृक्तौ

.
--2 As if, as it were
(denoting उत्प्रेक्षा); पश्यामीव पिताकिनं
Ś. 1. 6; लिंपतीव तमोंगानि वर्षतीवांजनं
नभः

.
--3 A little,
somewhat, perhaps; कडार इवायं G. M.
--4 (Added to interrogative words),
‘Possibly’, ‘I should like to
know’, ‘indeed’; विना सीतादेव्या
किमिव हि न दुःखं रघुपतेः

; क
इव of what sort, what-like; क इव
कालः

what a long time has
elapsed.
--5 इव is frequently used
with adverbs, especially with such
as involve restriction, by way of
emphasis in the sense of even or
just so, just, exactly, quite,
indeed, very; मुहूर्तमिव but for a
moment; किंचिदिव just a little bit;
so ईषदिव, नाचिरादिव &c.; (इव is
considered by grammarians as forming
compounds with the word after
which it stands; इवेन नित्यसमासो
विभक्त्यलोपश्च).

ईवत् a.
1 Going.
--2 So large, so
stately or magnificent.
